The algorithms we design in Guidance, Control and Navigation (GCN) lie at the heart of all of the highly complex MBDA missile and weapon systems. We’re involved in every phase of the product’s life cycle, from concept through to service.
Salary: £31,900 plus a £3000 joining bonus

What we can offer you:
•
2 year Programme: Starting September 2027
•
Annual Salary Review
•
Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)
•
Pension: Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%

Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime

•
Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days

Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.
The opportunity:
In this role, you’ll build your skills across our four specialist areas;
•
Guidance - figuring out a suitable trajectory, providing an effective route to target interception and improving the probability of defeating a target
•
Control - designing and tuning autopilot algorithms, for various control surfaces, to maintain stable flight dynamics and achieve the guidance demands
•
Navigation - estimating the current missile state (position, velocity and altitude/orientation) using measurements from a range of on-board sensors
•
Command and Control - designing weapon-system level algorithms to track and evaluate incoming threats, plan engagements, and provide additional mission context to the operator
This is a great environment and opportunity to learn, broadening your technical knowledge of the design and function of a complex weapon system through visibility of a wide range of work; from researching and developing futuristic technologies through to being on the design team for current high-profile projects.
Join a supportive and experienced team who will encourage you to develop your skills in coding and modelling, mathematics, flight dynamics and control theory – as well as utilising tools such as MATLAB/SIMULINK daily.
You’ll experience a variety of activities in this role, which could include:
•
Integrated navigation, such as 'Terrain Reference Navigation', 'GPS integration', and ‘Image Based Navigation’
•
Autopilot and control system design and analysis, including dual-mode control, thrust vector control, etc.
•
Algorithms for mid-course guidance, terminal guidance, target tracking and selectivity
•
Data fusion to combine data from multiple sensors. For example, radars, seekers, IMUs, etc.
•
Implementing AI techniques including neural networks and deep learning to improve traditional GCN algorithms and solve new challenges
•
Designing autonomous decision-making systems for use in complex collective missions.
Work collaboratively across engineering teams to develop your understanding of propulsion, aerodynamics, seekers, sensors and actuators, and how these technologies integrate within a complex missile system. Experience working within one of the many international teams in MBDA, with the GCN function in Paris and Rome - This doesn’t necessarily equate to travel but you may be offered the option where the opportunity arises.

Degree qualified in Physics, Mathematical Sciences, Engineering or Computing discipline to a minimum of 2:2

A CAWDE Operator at the Airbus Filton plant operates Electroimpact’s 5-axis Composite Automated Wing Drilling Equipment (CAWDE) to execute high-precision drilling, countersinking, and temporary bolt insertion during the assembly of A400M wing boxes.
Role Overview
• Location: Airbus Filton Facility (Bristol, UK)
• Program: Airbus A400M Military Transport Aircraft Wing Production
• Primary Equipment: Electroimpact 5-Axis Traveling-Column CNC Post Mill with ride-on operator platform
• Materials Worked: Multi-material stacks including Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastic (CFRP) wing skins, aluminum/titanium ribs, composite spars, and engine pylon reinforcements.

Location: London

About the role
AI is rewriting how people find and buy. Discovery is shifting from keyword search boxes to conversational, agent-mediated experiences - across both a brand's owned platforms and the AI surfaces where customers increasingly begin their journey. We are looking for a technically strong architect to lead the design and delivery of Google-powered AI commerce experiences - with intelligent, AI-native search and discovery at the core, extending across the wider set of on-platform agentic commerce use cases.
You will work at the intersection of enterprise commerce platforms and Google's agentic AI stack - Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Google Cloud Agents, Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, and the Customer Engagement Suite - translating commerce strategy into production-grade, grounded, and commercially reliable AI systems.
This role leans into Google Cloud AI platforms as the delivery foundation. Search and discovery is your anchor specialism, but your remit spans the broader on-platform agentic commerce agenda: conversational commerce, personalization, merchandising optimization, product knowledge and content, and the GEO / AI-native discoverability that determines whether a brand shows up accurately in LLM-mediated discovery.
You are hands-on, technically rigorous, and comfortable owning the technical design of a solution workstream - making well-reasoned build-vs-buy decisions and translating complex architecture into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior client stakeholders.

• Owning the technical design of AI-powered commerce search and discovery workstreams on Vertex AI Search for Commerce — relevance tuning, ranking, retrieval, merchandising controls, and query understanding — and ensuring the approach is scalable, grounded, and aligned to client constraints.

• Contributing to build-vs-buy decisions across Google AI platform services, LLM/model choices (incl. Model Garden), orchestration frameworks, and vector stores — with a well-reasoned technical point of view grounded in delivery experience.
• Embedding AI governance, observability, and responsible AI into design as first-class concerns - audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation, grounding/hallucination controls, brand safety, and performance monitoring.
• Providing technical leadership to delivery teams — guiding engineers, reviewing technical decisions, and maintaining architectural coherence across the workstream lifecycle.
• Leading technical workshops and architecture reviews with client stakeholders — presenting options with clear trade-offs, effort implications, and business outcomes for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Supporting the development of Accenture Song's AI commerce capability — contributing to reference architectures, accelerators, and points of view that advance our delivery standards.
What We Are Looking For
Required Experience
• ~6 years of professional experience in technical architecture, solution engineering, or software engineering — with meaningful delivery across enterprise platforms and a growing specialism in AI and agentic systems.
• Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI-powered search, discovery, or recommendation systems in production - relevance, ranking, retrieval, and query understanding.
• Demonstrable, hands-on experience with Google Cloud AI platforms applied to commerce - one or more of Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, or the Customer Engagement Suite.
• Hands-on experience with Generative AI and agentic systems - LLM-powered application design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and at least one agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI).
• Experience designing and building data and context pipelines for AI systems -=embedding pipelines, vector databases, and semantic search over structured commerce data.
• Hands-on delivery on at least one major enterprise commerce platform - such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Commercetools, SAP Commerce, or a composable / MACH-aligned stack - and a solid understanding of how these integrate with surrounding enterprise systems.
• Familiarity with emerging agentic commerce protocols - MCP, A2A, or ACP - and how they connect AI agents to commerce systems and product data.
• Working knowledge of cloud-native services and CI/CD-based delivery (GCP preferred).
• Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI - observability, tracing, auditability, grounding, and guardrails in production AI systems.
• Experience leading technical design sessions and presenting architecture options to senior client or stakeholder audiences.
Preferred Experience
• Familiarity with GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI-native search — how product data must be structured and exposed to remain visible and accurate in LLM-mediated discovery.
• Experience with Google's broader agent ecosystem - Model Garden, Agent Engine, AgentOps, and grounding/RAG on enterprise data.
• Hands-on AgentOps / LLMOps practices - production monitoring, model evaluation, tracing, and continuous improvement for deployed AI systems.
• Exposure to composable commerce patterns - MACH principles, headless…

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. Cross-functional collaboration
• Act as the trusted link between Product and other functions across IG, including Compliance, Legal & Risk, resolving governance questions quickly rather than letting them become blockers.
• Train and support product managers on governance requirements, building governance literacy across the wider team.
• Support the Product Operations Lead, Product Domain Leads and CPO in preparing materials for senior governance committees.

We’re looking for an Equipment Maintenance Engineer at Tewkesbury to own the sustainment of our deployed test systems, ensuring reliability across mechanical, electrical, electronic and software components. If you thrive in a collaborative, high-trust environment where your expertise truly matters, this is your opportunity to shape performance, drive improvements and support aerospace excellence. As our Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you will own the sustainment, reliability, and improvement of over 150 test systems that underpin our entire product lifecycle. You’ll lead maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, and obsolescence management — working closely with our customer, technicians, and engineering teams to keep critical test equipment operational and compliant. These systems combine mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, and hydraulic/power distribution components — so this is a role that rewards broad engineering knowledge, problem-solving, and the ability to see the whole picture.

• Resolve production-stopping issues, quality escapes, and yield-limiting faults — fast and effectively.
• Manage all sustainment work via our Maintenance Management System (MMS): logging, tracking, and documenting every request, inspection, and activity.
• Maintain full configuration integrity of deployed test equipment — creating, updating, and releasing formal documentation alongside all engineering work.
• Run correlation tests across systems to ensure accurate data and smooth equipment handovers.
• Keep stakeholders and our customer clearly updated on progress, risks, and schedules.
• Support procurement of spares, sub-assemblies, and services to keep systems supported.
• Lead obsolescence management: identify ageing components, plan replacements, and coordinate upgrade packages.
• Investigate root causes, support audits, and drive corrective actions and non-conformance resolutions.
• Champion Health & Safety: write/review risk assessments, enforce safe working practices, and act as an authorised LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) competent person.
• Drive continuous improvement through lean initiatives and actively participate in internal and external quality audits.
• Embed Moog’s culture and values in everything you do.
What We’re Looking For
Essential
• HNC/HND or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a relevant engineering sector — ideally aerospace, test systems, or industrial maintenance.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability, with sound engineering judgement.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Visio).
• Willing and able to obtain UK Security Clearance.
• Able to work flexibly and occasionally outside standard hours to support critical maintenance.
Desirable
• Experience designing or maintaining multi-axis, closed-loop, servo-hydraulic or electromechanical test systems.
• Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, MMS, NX, AutoCAD, or LabVIEW.
• Knowledge of robotics or automation systems.
• Understanding of aerospace quality standards and maintenance processes.
• Experience working directly with customers or cross-functional global teams.
Personal Qualities
• A natural team player who thrives in multi-disciplinary environments.
• Highly organised — able to manage up to 10 concurrent activities and prioritise effectively.
• Proactive, reliable, and comfortable making sound technical judgements under pressure.
• Committed to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
• Aligned with Moog’s values: Trust, Competence, Team Spirit, Diligence, Accountability, Effective Communication, Adaptability, Recognition, and Enjoyment.

• Good practical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work accurately to tight tolerances and specifications.

• Reliable, punctual, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
• Flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern.

• Cleanroom experience.
• Experience operating coating equipment or other technical production machinery.

• Manual handling activities in line with company procedures.

Job Description
Investment Operations Associate
UK Investment Operations  ·  IG Group  ·  Hybrid (London, 3 days in office)
About IG
IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses. The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your Team
Our UK Investment Operations team is responsible for running, controlling and improving the investment services IG offers. As an Investment Operations Associate, your role will span across investments and share dealing operations: IG Smart Portfolios, our managed portfolio service for UK investors delivered in partnership with BlackRock, and our share dealing platform, where you will work alongside the product team to help deliver a world-class investment experience. We are growing our investment range into thematic investing and you will be involved in building that out.
This is a hands-on operational role. You will support the day-to-day management of our model portfolios, own the monthly reporting cycle, and act as the investment point of contact for queries escalated from our client-facing teams. You will also contribute to client-facing investment material.
The role sits at a crossroads between product, marketing, compliance and the operations team. You will act as the bridge between these groups, making sure operational requirements are understood, changes are coordinated, and nothing falls between the cracks as our investment services grow.

Portfolio operations
• Supporting day-to-day management of the model portfolios across risk profiles, ensuring each stays aligned to its mandate, target risk band and strategic asset allocation
• Running portfolio rebalancing operations
• Contributing to ETF selection and ongoing due diligence

• Working with asset servicing and technology teams so that system changes are specified, built and tested correctly, with no regressions to portfolio or trading workflows
Risk, attribution and performance reporting
• Maintaining and developing our portfolio risk and volatility models, including the covariance matrix, ex ante volatility and risk decomposition across asset classes and risk profiles
• Producing performance attribution, breaking down returns by asset class, building block and allocation decision
• Owning the monthly reporting cycle and delivering accurate, timely analytics to internal stakeholders and governance forums
• Improving our reporting frameworks and analytical tooling to make them more accurate and more efficient
Investment commentary and client material
• Writing the monthly investment commentary on markets, portfolio positioning and performance
• Producing client investment material, including educational content, market reviews and communications
• Updating performance charts for marketing material each month
• Making sure all commentary and client-facing material passes compliance sign-off before release
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
Essential
• Excel modelling skills, and familiarity with Bloomberg
• Familiarity with ETFs and an understanding of core risk metrics such as volatility, tracking error and risk contribution
• Clear written English, with the ability to explain investment performance to a retail audience
• Care and accuracy in operational work, with sound judgement about when to escalate
Nice to have
• IMC candidacy or progress towards it
• Experience in share dealing operations or investment operations
• Experience of performance attribution or risk reporting in a multi-asset or model portfolio setting
• Data and dashboarding skills, for example Tableau, Looker or similar tools

• Knowledge of corporate actions operations

What you'll need
You care about how investment processes are built, not just that they work today. When something looks right on the surface, you still ask whether there is a gap underneath.
You are naturally curious and collaborative, and you look at existing workflows with a view to optimising them rather than accepting them as given. You spot operational risks before they become problems, whether that is a manual step that should be automated, a data source that is not being validated, or a handoff between teams where information could be lost. You raise these proactively and work with the people around you to fix them.
This role sits in a fast-moving business and it will stretch you. We are looking for a self-starter who wants to challenge the status quo rather than inherit it, and who embodies our three core values: champion the client, learn fast together and raise the bar.

Your personal and professional development matter to us. About Us
Let’s go on an adventure together!
Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.
For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.
At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers —  you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.
Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.
Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.
About the Role
Do you believe travel can change lives?
Not just for travellers — but for the people and places they visit?
Do you thrive in unpredictable days, long bus rides, spontaneous problem-solving, and conversations with strangers who quickly feel like friends?
Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
At G Adventures, we don’t call our tour leaders “tour leaders.” We call them Chief Experience Officers (CEOs). Our founder gave up the title because he believes the true leaders of this company are the ones out in the world, face-to-face with our travellers every single day.
You’re not just running a trip.
You’re shaping an experience.
You’re the reason a good tour becomes an unforgettable one.
Before we go further, please ensure you are legally able to lead tours through the following countries:
• United Kingdom
What You’ll Actually Be Doing
This role lives at the intersection of logistics, leadership, storytelling, and heart.
On any given day, you’ll be:
• Managing group dynamics
• Coordinating transport and suppliers
• Sharing the culture, history, and nuance of a place
• Supporting community partners
• Helping travellers feel like they truly belong
You’re not just guiding people through a destination. You’re helping them understand it.
What Makes a Great CEO
You don’t just do the job — you live it.
You:
• Believe in community tourism and responsible travel
• Champion G for Good and our Raise the World efforts on tour
• Communicate clearly with travellers, suppliers, and offices
• Bring calm, positivity, and energy to long, unpredictable days
• Handle the unexpected like it’s part of the plan
• Turn information into stories travellers will never forget
• Create a sense of safety, inclusion, and belonging within your group
• Stay endlessly curious about the places you guide in
You Travel Your Heart Out — and it shows.
The Practical Stuff
On each departure, you’ll:
• Be the face of G Adventures in the field
• Manage day-to-day logistics and reservations
• Promote Planeterra and G for Good initiatives
• Support optional activities, meals, and traveller needs
• Handle incidents calmly and professionally
• Maintain budgets, receipts, and daily accounts
• Provide post-trip reports and updates
• Occasionally support the training of new CEOs
What You’ll Need
• Valid First Aid/CPR
• Basic budgeting and accounting comfort
• A valid passport/visa and required vaccinations
• Comfort using Google Suite and mobile apps
• Experience in tourism, hospitality, or extensive travel
• Strong English language skills
• Willingness to undergo a background check if required
• Valid UK or Irish passport and have the legal right to live and work in both the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland without requiring visa sponsorship
Why This Role Is Different
You won’t sit behind a desk.
You won’t have two days that look the same.
You won’t just be guiding tours.
You’ll be creating moments travellers talk about for the rest of their lives — while helping the people and places you visit, too.
If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we can’t wait to meet you.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. What you’ll do
ICM platform configuration and solution delivery
• Translate incentive-plan requirements, terms and conditions, and business rules into effective ICM platform configurations.
• Own or contribute to functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-release validation for new plans, plan changes, and enhancements.
• Document calculation logic, data flows, configuration decisions, dependencies, and operational procedures.
• Identify opportunities to use ICM platform capabilities, best practices, and approved AI tools to improve reliability, scalability, and user experience.
• Use AI-assisted approaches to accelerate requirements analysis, configuration drafting, reuse of proven patterns, identification of edge cases, and preparation of configuration documentation; validate all AI-generated outputs against approved requirements and controls.
Data integrations and data quality
• Own or support data integrations into the ICM platform from HR, attainment, and other operational data sources.
• Monitor data loads and investigate failures, missing records, mapping issues, and data-quality exceptions.
• Partner with Analytics, Data/Engineering, and HR Operations to validate source data and reconcile discrepancies.
• Use SQL to inspect, validate, and troubleshoot data across multiple sources.
Testing, release management, and controls
• Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, regression coverage, and release evidence.
• Use AI-supported QA to compare requirements with configurations, expand test coverage, identify inconsistencies, summarize test results, and highlight likely regression risks, with human review before release decisions.
• Validate plan calculations and downstream outputs when configurations change or defects are fixed.
• Apply disciplined change-management practices, including documentation, approvals, testing, and traceability through the team’s ticketing and backlog processes.
• Support SOX and audit requirements related to plan configuration, data connections, user access, and change management.
Operational support and troubleshooting
• Support Incentive Operations during payout and accrual cycles, including investigation of calculation errors, data discrepancies, and system issues.
• Triage production problems, assess impact, coordinate resolution, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.
• Work with the ICM platform vendor support team to diagnose critical errors, test fixes, and coordinate safe production rollouts.
• Use AI-assisted triage and analysis to summarize errors, identify patterns across incidents, develop root-cause hypotheses, and accelerate runbook updates.
• Help turn recurring incidents into permanent fixes, improved controls, or clearer operating procedures.
Access, backlog, and stakeholder management
• Review and manage user access rights and support license provisioning in the ICM platform.
• Maintain a prioritized backlog of features, configuration changes, defects, technical debt, and control improvements.
• Estimate effort, identify dependencies, and communicate timelines and risks for delivery work.
• Build trusted relationships with technical and non-technical partners, explaining system behavior and trade-offs in a clear, practical way.
What we’re looking for
Required experience and skills
• Four or more years of hands-on programming, configuration, or technical administration in an Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform such as Captivate IQ, SAP Callidus Commissions, Varicent or comparable platforms.
• Practical experience configuring calculation logic, testing plan changes, troubleshooting defects, and supporting production releases.
• Strong SQL skills and experience integrating, validating, or reconciling data from multiple sources.
• Demonstrated ability to create structured test plans, test cases, test scripts, and regression coverage.
• Ability to translate business requirements and incentive-plan rules into robust technical solutions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with close attention to detail.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to work effectively across Operations, Analytics, HR, Finance, IT, and vendor teams.
• Ability to manage competing priorities in a controlled, deadline-driven environment.
Helpful additional experience
• Understanding of sales incentive plans, pay cycles, accruals, attainment data, and terms and conditions.
• Experience with Workday or other HR-system data flows.
• Experience with data tools such as Querybook, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
• Experience and ability to use AI in ICM plan configuration and rollout, including configuration support, test design, regression analysis, defect triage, maintenance, and technical documentation.
• Experience using JIRA for ticketing, backlog, release, and change management.
• Experience applying SOX, audit, access-control, or other governance requirements to a compensation or financial-technology system.
• Curiosity, technical adaptability, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.
What success looks like
During your first 6–12 months, you will be making the platform and the operating model more dependable and easier to scale. Success will include:
• ICM platform configurations and plan changes are delivered with clear requirements, thorough testing, and reliable release evidence.
• ICM platform data integrations and loads are monitored proactively, with issues diagnosed and resolved before they affect payout or accrual cycles.
• Stakeholders have clear documentation of calculation logic, data flows, controls, and operational procedures.
• Production issues are triaged quickly, communicated clearly, and converted into lasting fixes or process improvements.
• Access, change-management, and audit controls are consistently applied.
• Backlog reflects business priorities, realistic estimates, visible dependencies, and clear ownership.
• AI is used thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work and improve speed and quality without weakening data privacy, access controls, auditability, or human accountability.

As the world of retail evolves, we, as a business, believe that for all other parts of the chain to work, our stores must set the tone of what our two brands are all about.  Irrespective of where our consumers eventually make a purchase, our stores, are always a window to our great brands.  As a result our locations are paramount, the first class experience must be a given and our in-store standards should never be questionable.

• Clearly communicate to staff all marketing and sales promotions.

• Consistently foster a positive store experience by treating all customers and colleagues in a fair and consistent manner.
• Support the team in delivering the business strategy, and ensuring everyone has received consistent training on product knowledge and store maintenance.

• Focus staff on the importance of quality relationships with internal & external customers.
• Ensure staff accountability of building a repeat customer base by providing all customers with unparalleled spirited service.

Senior AI Platform Engineer - Knowledge & Reasoning
Location: Prague (Hybrid); Czech Republic (Remote); UK (Remote); Ghent (Hybrid), Poland (Remote), Hungary (Remote), Romania (Remote)
Function: Software Engineering
Reports to: Team Leader, Esko AI
About the role
The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed, we must ingest and leverage expert knowledge to augment the capabilities of our AI agents and services. This capability will be a key part of Esko’s centralized AI platform, enabling wider teams to build AI into their products using a common base.
Packaging workflows are governed by knowledge of very different kinds: regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, QRD), technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions, and practices that currently live in the heads of experts. Some of this knowledge is binding, some advisory, some contradictory, and much of it applies only to a particular customer, brand, or specific range of designs.
For AI systems to operate reliably in this environment, they must do more than retrieve relevant information. They need to determine which knowledge applies, distinguish mandatory requirements from guidance, handle missing or conflicting evidence, and recognize when human judgement is required.
We are building knowledge and reasoning as a shared capability of Esko's AI Platform, enabling product teams to create AI-powered workflows grounded in trusted, contextual knowledge. As part of the platform team, you will help shape and build this capability, taking end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas.
What you will do
• Design the knowledge representation: how constraints, transformations, procedures, and guidelines are modelled so that both agents and deterministic validators can use them, and so that humans can read, curate and correct them.
• Build and operate platform services for ingesting, curating, retrieving, and versioning knowledge, ensuring it is scoped correctly to the relevant customer and workflow context.
• Define how semantic retrieval, deterministic validation, and human review work together, including how applicability, uncertainty, conflicting evidence, and escalation are handled.
• Design and implement reusable APIs and tools that allow AI systems and deterministic services to apply, validate, and explain contextual knowledge.
• Build evaluation suites covering retrieval quality, applicability, conflict and ambiguity handling, and explanation quality, using measurable results as the primary evidence of progress.
• Take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas, including their security, tenant isolation, reliability, observability, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams.
• Work directly with domain experts and product engineering teams to turn informal expertise into structured, testable knowledge with clear provenance, citation, and release practices.
What we are looking for
• Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language.
• At least 5 years’ experience in a software engineering role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
• Experience building knowledge, retrieval, or rule systems that other teams depend on, and the judgement to choose the right formalism for a problem, whether that is a schema, decision table, rules engine, graph, or retrieval.
• Practical experience with RAG, information extraction, and structured validation (JSON Schema, Pydantic, or equivalent).
• Sound judgement when reasoning about applicability, exceptions, missing evidence, and ambiguity, including recognizing when a system should decline to answer or require human review.
• Experience constructing evaluation datasets, and the ability to write clearly about modelling decisions, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
• Undergraduate, Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines.
• Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the domain engineering teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.
Preferred experience
• Semantic and symbolic tooling (RDF/OWL, SHACL, Datalog, DMN, production rule engines, policy-as-code).
• Agentic systems with tools calling and validation-before-action.
• Multi-tenant SaaS with strict isolation and audit requirements.
• Experience in a high-accountability domain such as pharmaceutical or food labelling, and legal technology.
• Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry.
What success looks like
• Delivery of the knowledge module, conforming to agreed specifications and architecture, in a way that delivers measurable improvements in AI agent and service effectiveness (e.g. increased end-user productivity).
• Product teams build shared knowledge services rather than constructing their own.
• Agents apply the correct tenant-, market-, and customer-specific constraints with measurably high recall, can explain which knowledge items influenced a recommendation or validation result, and escalate rather than guess when knowledge is ambiguous, conflicting, or absent.
• Tenant-specific knowledge never crosses tenant boundaries.
• The knowledge base itself is versioned, tested, legible – and curatable by the humans who must ultimately stand behind it.
• Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko’s Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices.
• The knowledge module grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.
What We Offer
• Joining a highly experienced and long-established engineering hub in Prague
• Flexibility to shape and grow the MLOps function - you will be our internal expert
• Opportunity to collaborate internationally across multiple product teams
• At Veralto, your potential is amplified. Our culture of continuous improvement defines who we are, drives our success, and translates to a career without limits for our team of curious associates
At Esko, a Veralto Company, innovation comes in every color and never in the same package. Join Esko and see how diversity of people and thought fuels a career journey like no other. Job Title: Associate Principal Scientist – Upstream Process Development (Temporary Maternity Cover)
Introduction to role:
Are you ready to lead upstream science that shapes robust, scalable biologics processes and accelerates medicines to patients? Based in Cambridge, UK, this temporary maternity-cover role ensures continuity and momentum for key programs by owning upstream mammalian cell culture process development through critical CMC stages.
You will connect day-to-day experimentation with strategic delivery, translating cell culture insights into decisions that de-risk manufacturing and enable clinical supply. Working through matrix teams rather than direct line management, you will coordinate scientists, technicians and operators while partnering closely with analytical, formulation, engineering, manufacturing, quality and regulatory experts.
In this role you will plan, execute and interpret CHO-based fed-batch and perfusion studies, drive process intensification and media/feed optimization, and guide scale-up and technology transfer to internal facilities and external partners. How will you apply data-driven methods and mechanistic understanding to define operating ranges that stand up in the plant?
Accountabilities:
• Scientific Leadership across CMC: Own upstream process development work packages across development cycles, maintaining delivery plans, milestones and governance commitments to keep programs on track.
• Mammalian Cell Culture Design: Design, coordinate and interpret CHO-based inoculum, fed-batch and perfusion studies, including media and feed optimization and process intensification, to improve productivity and robustness.
• Laboratory Execution Oversight: Plan and oversee high-throughput and bench-scale bioreactor work using ambr platforms and stirred-tank bioreactors, ensuring scientific rigor, traceable documentation, quality and agreed timelines.
• Data-Driven Optimization: Apply mechanistic understanding, Design of Experiments, multivariate analysis and modelling to identify process drivers, define operating ranges, assess robustness and inform risk-based decisions.
• Product and Process Insight: Integrate growth, viability, metabolism, productivity, product quality and stability data to draw authoritative conclusions and recommend next steps with clear evidence.
• Systems Biology and Modelling Support: Contribute to multi-omics and metabolic modelling initiatives that inform media/feed strategies and process optimization where required.
• Documentation and Governance: Lead preparation, review and approval of experimental plans, SOPs, data records, development reports, process descriptions and CMC documentation suitable for governance and regulatory submissions.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Represent upstream development on project and CMC teams, communicating progress, risks and recommendations while coordinating timely input from analytical, formulation, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and project management partners.
• Scale-Up and Technology Transfer: Support transfers to internal manufacturing, CMOs and external partners, including authoring transfer packages, troubleshooting and on-the-floor manufacturing support.
• Portfolio and External Management: Manage concurrent internal and external activities, balancing resources and scientific risk to maintain efficient portfolio delivery.
• Mentoring and Matrix Leadership: Provide day-to-day technical guidance, training and coordination to less-experienced colleagues through matrix ways of working; no direct line management.
• Platform and Operational Excellence: Drive laboratory operational excellence, evaluate equipment and technologies, champion digital record keeping and continuous improvement to sustain an effective upstream platform.
• Safety and Compliance: Ensure adherence to Safety, Health and Environment requirements, quality systems, Good Laboratory Science practices and company standards.
• Flexibility in Operations: Support occasional weekend or extended hours for active cell culture or manufacturing campaigns and collaborate across time zones; occasional travel to other sites or partner facilities.
Essential Skills/Experience:
• Degree in biochemical engineering, bioprocessing, biotechnology, biology or a related scientific discipline, with substantial relevant industry experience.
• Strong theoretical and practical expertise in mammalian upstream process development, preferably using CHO cell culture.
• Hands-on experience with aseptic cell culture, inoculum expansion and bench-scale or high-throughput bioreactor systems.
• Demonstrated ability to independently plan, execute, analyse and report complex process-development studies.
• Working knowledge of Design of Experiments, statistical analysis and data-driven process optimisation.
• Experience contributing to CMC development, technical reports, process documentation or regulatory-supporting content.
• Ability to lead work through matrix teams, manage concurrent priorities and communicate clear, evidence-based scientific recommendations.
• Understanding of Safety, Health & Environment, quality and compliance requirements in a pharmaceutical R&D laboratory.
Desirable Skills/Experience:
• PhD or master’s degree in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline.
• Experience across early and later CMC development cycles, process characterisation, scale-up or technology transfer.
• Experience with ambr250 or comparable high-throughput platforms and stirred-tank bioreactors.
• Knowledge of perfusion, process intensification, media or feed development.
• Proficiency with JMP, SIMCA, Design-Expert, Python, MATLAB or comparable analytical tools.

The Head of Digital Delivery will provide the vision, strategic architecture, and operational leadership required to build and scale United Infrastructure’s UK digital delivery function from the ground up. You will work in direct partnership with the Engineering Director to architect a robust department growth strategy aligned with overarching engineering and business targets.
This role is a unique hybrid of strategic capability building and hands-on technical pioneering. You will lead the deployment of BIM, Reality Capture, and advanced Data Management systems, while actively developing bespoke AI automation use cases targeting underground cabling, overhead line (OHL) design, and substation automation. Your mission is to position United Infrastructure at the absolute forefront of digital innovation within the UK Power Transmission and Distribution (T&D) sector.
Key Responsibilities
Departmental Strategy, Growth & Leadership
• Architect and execute the growth strategy for the new Digital Delivery department, defining team structures, resource requirements, and headcount business cases to scale the team from in line with departmental targets.
• Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the Engineering Director, translating corporate engineering goals into a measurable digital delivery roadmap.
• Establish departmental KPIs, budgets, and operational frameworks to ensure the new team delivers high-quality, high-efficiency support across all active EPC frameworks.
Specialized AI Automation & Innovation
• Pioneer and implement AI automation tools and computational scripts (e.g., via Dynamo, Python, or proprietary AI models) specifically focused on driving engineering efficiencies in:
• Underground Cabling: Automated route optimization, cable pulling calculations, and thermal analysis integrations.
• Overhead Lines (OHL): Algorithmic tower spotting, profiling, sag/tension automation, and vegetation management predictive tools.
• Substations: Automated protection schematics, modular layout generation, and standardized wiring configuration scripts.
• Institutionalize 4D simulations (via Synchro / Fuzor) and Virtual Reality (VR) environments to optimize client design reviews and stakeholder engagement.
Core Digital Frameworks & Oversight
• BIM Implementation: Establish and govern rigorous transmission / distribution compliant BIM standards, QA/QC workflows, and standardized clash detection / resolution reporting models across all complex major projects.
• Reality Capture: Implement a robust framework for site data capture—incorporating laser scanning, point clouds, and UAV topology mapping—and embed this into the active design and asset verification lifecycle.
• Data Management: Own the strategy for the Common Data Environment (CDE), enforcing strict metadata governance, asset data drops (COBie), and information security protocols across the engineering practice.
Commercial, Bidding & Client Relations
• Formulate the digital and BIM execution strategies for major bids, overseeing the preparation of cost proposals, qualification statements, and innovative digital tenders.
• Champion United Infrastructure’s digital and AI capabilities in client presentations, industry publications, and technical panels to drive new business opportunities and showcase market leadership.
• Build influential relationships with clients, contractors, and industry bodies, presenting technical reports at conferences and publishing in industry journals to position the company as a market leader.

Essential Experience
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical/civil engineering, Construction Management, or an accredited digital infrastructure field.
• BIM & Software Expertise: Minimum 10 years of experience overseeing complex BIM frameworks across diverse teams, with expert-level proficiency in tools like Revit, Navisworks, Synchro, Dynamo, Fuzor, Power BI, and BIM360/ACC.
• Sector Expertise: Minimum 5 years of experience in the UK Transmission & Distribution (T&D) industry, with a deep understanding of NGET / SSE Standards, site requirements, and complex substation / linear asset designs.
• Entrepreneurial Capabilities: Proven experience building a team, sub-department, or strategic initiative from the ground up, including headcount planning and budget management.
• Automation Background: Demonstrable experience applying computational design, scripting, or AI-driven automation to engineering workflows (ideally within OHL, cabling, or substations)
• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Desirable

• Hybrid working arrangement (Dependent upon role)

• Professional membership and chartership support

Big responsibility. Personal support. That’s Beyond the Ordinary.

Audit at BDO gives you the chance to take on meaningful work early in your career. We’re the only UK mid-market organisation with more than £1bn in turnover and 8,000 people. Lead the Future of Retail
At UNIQLO, we believe clothing should be simple, high-quality, functional, and built to last, in order to make everyone’s life better. That's the heart of LifeWear.
The UMC Graduate Programme is a 12-month accelerated leadership journey designed for ambitious graduates ready to shape the future of one of the world's most dynamic global retailers. Expect a fast pace, a steep learning curve, and the chance to make a real impact in a business landscape that is always evolving, and where your contributions and ideas truly matter.
What You'll Gain
Throughout the year, you'll be supported by team members, managers and senior leaders who’ve been where you are and are determined to fast-track your career.
•
Mentoring and direct communications with your COO
•
Training in store operations, finance, people management and more
•
Participation to the UNIQLO Europe Leadership Convention in London
•
A network of diverse and supportive colleagues united by a shared purpose
Programme Structure
Months 1–4 | Discover the Business & Master the Foundations:
You'll begin by immersing yourself in the engine of UNIQLO: our stores. Your learning will happen directly on the shop floor rather than in an office setting. This is where you'll build a deep understanding of our customers, our products, and what makes our operations world-class.
You'll learn and master:
•
Customer service
•
Product deliveries & replenishment
•
Omni-channel & checkout operations
•
Onboarding and training new starters
•
Product category management
Months 5-6 | Step into Leadership
As a supervisor, you'll begin leading teams on the shop floor, influencing performance, and owning your first commercial responsibilities. This stage develops your leadership stance, building trust, driving results, and bringing out the best in the people around you.
You'll take on:
•
Team coordination & daily planning
•
Developing the performance of your colleagues
•
Operational excellence and customer satisfaction
•
Ownership of a key subdivision, ensuring day to day performance
Months 7–12 | Drive the Business
In your final rotation, on top of maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor as an assistant manager, you'll work alongside the Store Manager to influence commercial decisions and operational strategy.
You'll be responsible for:
•
Sales analytics & KPI performance
•
Inventory & commercial planning
•
Layout optimization & store standards
•
Workforce planning aligned with sales forecasts
•
Team development & succession planning
What We Offer:
•
Competitive salary, guaranteed bonus & group profit sharing
•
Full-time permanent contract
•
30% staff discount across all Fast-Retailing brands
•
Two paid volunteer days per year
•
Opportunities for fast career progression at the end of the programme (eligibility for promotion every 6 months)
•
Relocation support after your second rotation (if required)
•
Locations: London, Birmingham, Bristol, Leeds, Liverpool, Manchester, Glasgow and Edinburgh
Minimum Requirements:
•
Bachelor's or master's degree with permanent work authorization in the UK (Or if you hold a Graduate visa, this needs to be valid for at least 18 months, from the time you start working with us)
•
Ready to start full-time in January or September 2027
•
Minimum B2 level English
•
Flexible to work weekends and varied shifts
•
Open to relocation within the UK

•
Step 1: Online Assessments (Including English proficiency tests)

Step 5: Final Interview
